about: The Arts: Overlook's subclasses (bible/05-Decisions/Arts Are Overlook's Subclasses.md), with Claude's numbers (Arts and Loadouts as Claude Shapes Them.md). Read by the rules (the gear crate) and the client alike. Times in seconds, distances in metres, damage before power as a weapon's is; element by the gear crate's numbers (1 Blaze, 2 Volt, 3 Cosmic).

anima.name: Tempest
anima.text: Six orbs of lightning leave you and seek the nearest enemies, turning to another when theirs falls.

tenets.name: Quicken
tenets.text: You and every player near you move faster for a short time.

tenets.name: Arc Lash
tenets.text: Lightning lashes the enemies in front of you, damaging and paralysing them.

core.name: Momentum
core.text: Quicken also gives you Crit while it lasts.

core.name: Recharge
core.text: Each Volt kill takes 4% off your Tenets' cooldowns.

core.name: Overload
core.text: Enemies you Charge are Exposed too.

core.name: Gale
core.text: Quicken lasts 3 s longer and reaches 18 m.

arts.name: Divine
arts.blurb: A master of its craft, raising those beside it.

anima.name: Sunwell
anima.text: An orb of sun hangs where you cast it, linking every player near it: healing them and raising their damage.

tenets.name: Dawnflare
tenets.text: A small bird of fire makes a strafing run ahead of you, burning the enemies near its path.

core.name: Radiance
core.text: The Sunwell reaches 3 m further and lasts 4 s longer.

core.name: Mercy
core.text: Mend also heals players within 8 m half as much.

core.name: Wings
core.text: The Dawnflare makes a second pass back.

core.name: Zeal
core.text: While Linked, each Blaze kill takes 5% off your Tenets' cooldowns.

core.name: Searing
core.text: The Dawnflare Exposes what it burns.

anima.name: Duskraven
anima.text: A raven of dusk follows you, its bolts making enemies take more damage and healing you for half what they deal.

tenets.name: Dusk Daggers
tenets.text: Hold to aim, let go to cast: cosmic daggers whirl there, damaging enemies and Exposing them.

tenets.name: Vanish
tenets.text: A dodge roll into a short invisibility. Attacking breaks it; a backstab from it always crits.

core.name: Hunger
core.text: The Duskraven heals you all it deals, not half.

core.name: Blades
core.text: Dusk Daggers reach 1.5 m further and last 2 s longer.

core.name: Hunt
core.text: A crit out of Vanish gives back half its cooldown.

core.name: Dread
core.text: Each Cosmic kill on an Exposed enemy keeps the Duskraven 2 s longer.

core.name: Cruelty
core.text: Your crits on Exposed enemies deal 10% more.
